tickets.description: Currently, the application version is hardcoded in multiple files across the backend and frontend. Every release requires updating the version in many different locations, making the process error-prone and difficult to maintain. Refactor the project so that the version is maintained in a single authoritative location (or the minimum number of canonical locations if one location is not technically feasible). The solution should: - Identify where the application version is currently defined and used. - Determine the true source(s) of the version. - Introduce a central version provider/configuration if necessary. - Update all consumers to obtain the version from the central source instead of hardcoding it. - Remove duplicated version literals wherever possible. - Preserve existing runtime behavior. - Ensure UI, backend APIs, configuration, and other consumers continue displaying or using the correct version. - Avoid unnecessary architectural changes outside the scope of version management.
acceptance_criteria: Version is maintained in one canonical location
Hardcoded duplicate version values are removed where possible
All consumers obtain the version from the canonical source
tickets.title: Prefer using an existing configuration or version source if one already exists. Only introduce a new central version provider if no suitable canonical source exists
